scope: Fixed-state local cycles; offline route acquisition excluded; complete stages; all scheduled samples retained

primary_decision.selection_rule: Choose among the four predetermined variants by the geometric mean of development aggregate TPS ratios against dynamic probability, giving cold and natural modes equal weight; prefer the simpler method on an exact tie.
primary_decision.selection_rule_timing: Specified after complete development analysis and before any holdout measurement; not claimed preregistered before development.
rationale: The incremental method preserves the original expert decisions and has the best mode-balanced development score among the four added variants.
No added variant wins in both cache modes on development; primary status is only for heldout confirmation, not deployment or a claim of superiority.
The cache model changed only one of twelve natural-cache decisions, while adding resident-read and missing-work computation.
Acceptance calibration and the 2% guard showed mixed prompt-specific effects; all remain in the heldout ablation.
primary_decision.development_revisions_after_review: none; reachable-path-only training calibration still selected 0.75; a utility-floor counterfactual did not establish an acceptance guarantee and has unmeasured queries, so it remains an unimplemented candidate.
primary_decision.correctness_scope: Exact same-query BF16 logits, routes, acceptance, checkpoint restoration and commit checks; cross-query-shape greedy equivalence, full generation quality and online route acquisition are not established.
